adversarial_categories.notes: Cyclic prerequisite graphs do not infinite-loop. getOuterFringe terminates because prereq lookup is per-node on incoming edges; cycles are not traversed. The system handles them gracefully.
Empty cards + empty proficiencies → all untouched. Empty graph → empty Map. Cards-only and proficiency-only paths work correctly.
Future lastReviewedAt (> now) is clamped to deltaDays=0, producing retention=1.0 (treated as just-reviewed).
Negative and zero stability → retention=0 via stabilityToRetention clamp. No NaN produced in retention or mastery.
Positional last-wins behavior confirmed. Last entry in the array determines retention and isProficient.
Cards alone with review state → mastered. Learning state → inProgress. New state → inProgress. Stability without lastReviewedAt → retention=0, inProgress.
Identical input → identical output across multiple calls. No mutable state leaking.
